proves.claim: The spec tab, first and repeat click, paints under TAB_SPEED_GOAL_MS or its audited row in tab-speed-rows.mjs.

cli.journeys-init-perf-tab-speed-spec.sp.why: Without it, a spec tab that paints over its audited row on the large board would pass unnoticed, and the doctrine pair file would still run over its file budget.
